description: Returns tools available on the project.

parameters.name: filters[is_active]
parameters.description: When true, returns only active tools; when false, only inactive tools.

parameters.name: for_mobile
parameters.description: When true, limits results to tools supported by Procore mobile apps.

parameters.name: include_configurable_generic_tools
parameters.description: When true with for_mobile, includes configurable custom tools in the mobile result set.

is_active.description: Whether the tool is active on the project.

required.description: Whether the tool must remain active.
